sources.title: Meiosis in oocytes: predisposition to aneuploidy and its increased incidence with age.
sources.read_level: Actual original PubMed EFetch full abstract; not full text. Researcher read occurred after model generation.
sources.supports: BM04 distinguishes prophase-I arrest from whole-meiosis completion and the second metaphase-II arrest resolved by fertilization.
sources.role: Researcher appraisal only; never answering-agent evidence or a substitute key.

sources.title: Effects of simvastatin 40 mg daily on muscle and liver adverse effects in a 5-year randomized placebo-controlled trial in 20,536 high-risk people.
sources.authors_or_organization: MRC/BHF Heart Protection Study Collaborative Group, Jane Armitage, Louise Bowman, Rory Collins, Sarah Parish, Jonathan Tobert
sources.read_level: Actual PubMed EFetch full abstract after generation; not full text or agent evidence.
sources.supports: BM05 distinguishes the HPS background association from actual trial results: no significant serious hepatobiliary difference and undetectable hepatitis risk. Does not establish the rate of all mild transaminase elevations.
sources.role: Researcher appraisal only; not a scoring-key replacement.

sources.title: Metformin - LiverTox: Clinical and Research Information on Drug-Induced Liver Injury
sources.authors_or_organization: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases / National Library of Medicine
sources.read_level: Indexed official NCBI introduction/hepatotoxicity excerpt and PubMed book record; direct Bookshelf open was blocked by a browser check. No full direct page read claimed.
sources.supports: BM05: extremely rare but documented metformin liver injury means an absolute non-hepatotoxic claim is too broad. Not a dose/treatment recommendation.
sources.role: Researcher appraisal only; never supplied to the answering agent.

sources.title: Schistosomiasis - CDC Yellow Book: Health Information for International Travel
sources.authors_or_organization: Anne Straily and W. Evan Secor / Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.read_level: Direct official chapter, epidemiology and clinical-presentation sections.
sources.supports: BM13: acute schistosomiasis can include fever, diarrhea and hepatosplenomegaly; it is not exclusively chronic. S. japonicum rather than S. mansoni is the named Indonesian endemic species. Does not replace the released Typhi key.
sources.role: Post-generation researcher differential check; not model evidence.

sources.title: Outpatient Clinical Care for Adults - Antibiotic Prescribing and Use
sources.authors_or_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention / National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases
sources.read_level: Direct official adult-outpatient table, acute uncomplicated bronchitis section.
sources.supports: BM16: uncomplicated acute bronchitis should not be conflated with antibiotic-eligible COPD/chronic-bronchitis exacerbation. Does not deny the selected antibiotic option for the COPD vignette.
sources.role: Post-generation researcher terminology/scope check, not agent evidence.

sources.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (acute exacerbation): antimicrobial prescribing - NG114 recommendations
sources.authors_or_organization: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.read_level: Indexed official recommendation/table excerpt and evidence-summary excerpt; direct page open was blocked with 403. No direct full-guideline/PDF read claimed.
sources.supports: BM16: doxycycline is among first-choice oral options when an adult COPD exacerbation merits antibiotics; individual indication/severity/susceptibility matters. No dosing advice is given in this appraisal.
sources.role: Researcher context only, not model-delivered evidence or a replacement key.

sources.title: Glossary - Birth Defects Surveillance Toolkit
sources.authors_or_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention / Division of Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities
sources.read_level: Direct archived official definitions of embryo, gestational age, meningocele and neural tube closure.
sources.supports: BM19: closure is within 28 days after conception; distinguish embryonic dating from usual menstrual gestational dating. Meningocele is a spina-bifida form.
sources.role: Post-generation researcher terminology check; never model evidence or key replacement.

sources.title: Diagnosis, Evaluation, and Management of Ascites, Spontaneous Bacterial Peritonitis and Hepatorenal Syndrome: 2021 Practice Guidance by the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases
sources.authors_or_organization: Scott W. Biggins, Paulo Angeli, Guadalupe Garcia-Tsao, Pere Gines, Simon C. Ling, Mitra K. Nadim, Florence Wong, W. Ray Kim / AASLD
sources.read_level: Direct original publisher SBP diagnostic/management sections, including focal inflammation differential; not a full-article appraisal. PMID not verified and not asserted.
sources.supports: BM26: the neutrophil threshold supports presumptive infection management, but focal intra-abdominal inflammatory sources may also exceed it; do not infer cultures or exclude secondary peritonitis from the count alone.
sources.role: Post-generation researcher calibration check; never answering-agent evidence.
